appointments_context_valid.name: appointments_context_valid
appointments_context_valid.value: ("appointments"."appointment_type" = 'CHECK_IN' AND "appointments"."reservation_id" IS NOT NULL AND "appointments"."rental_id" IS NULL AND "appointments"."support_ticket_id" IS NULL) OR ("appointments"."appointment_type" = 'CHECK_OUT' AND "appointments"."reservation_id" IS NULL AND "appointments"."rental_id" IS NOT NULL AND "appointments"."support_ticket_id" IS NULL) OR ("appointments"."appointment_type" = 'SUPPORT' AND "appointments"."reservation_id" IS NULL AND "appointments"."rental_id" IS NULL)

facility_tasks_lifecycle_valid.name: facility_tasks_lifecycle_valid
facility_tasks_lifecycle_valid.value:
("facility_tasks"."status" = 'ASSIGNED' AND "facility_tasks"."started_at" IS NULL AND "facility_tasks"."completed_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("facility_tasks"."status" = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND "facility_tasks"."started_at" IS NOT NULL AND "facility_tasks"."completed_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("facility_tasks"."status" = 'COMPLETED' AND "facility_tasks"."started_at" IS NOT NULL AND "facility_tasks"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL)
        OR "facility_tasks"."status" = 'CANCELLED'

facility_tasks_reference_valid.name: facility_tasks_reference_valid
facility_tasks_reference_valid.value: ("facility_tasks"."type" = 'CHECK_IN_HANDOVER' AND "facility_tasks"."reference_type"::text IN ('BOOKING', 'APPOINTMENT')) OR ("facility_tasks"."type" = 'UNIT_INSPECTION' AND "facility_tasks"."reference_type"::text IN ('BOOKING', 'STORAGE_UNIT', 'APPOINTMENT')) OR ("facility_tasks"."type" = 'HANDLE_SUPPORT' AND "facility_tasks"."reference_type"::text IN ('SUPPORT_TICKET', 'APPOINTMENT'))

inspections_context_valid.name: inspections_context_valid
inspections_context_valid.value:
(
        ("inspections"."inspection_type" = 'CHECK_IN' AND num_nonnulls("inspections"."booking_id", "inspections"."reservation_id") = 1 AND "inspections"."rental_id" IS NULL) OR
        ("inspections"."inspection_type" = 'CHECK_OUT' AND "inspections"."rental_id" IS NOT NULL AND "inspections"."booking_id" IS NULL AND "inspections"."reservation_id" IS NULL) OR
        ("inspections"."inspection_type" = 'MAINTENANCE' AND "inspections"."booking_id" IS NULL AND "inspections"."reservation_id" IS NULL)
      )

inspections_completion_valid.name: inspections_completion_valid
inspections_completion_valid.value: ("inspections"."status" = 'PENDING' AND "inspections"."inspected_at" IS NULL AND "inspections"."inspect_done_at" IS NULL) OR ("inspections"."status" = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND "inspections"."inspected_at" IS NOT NULL AND "inspections"."inspect_done_at" IS NULL) OR ("inspections"."status" IN ('PASSED', 'FAILED') AND "inspections"."inspected_at" IS NOT NULL AND "inspections"."inspect_done_at" IS NOT NULL)

payments_context_valid.name: payments_context_valid
payments_context_valid.value: ("payments"."type" = 'CHARGE' AND num_nonnulls("payments"."booking_id", "payments"."reservation_id") = 1 AND "payments"."rental_id" IS NULL AND "payments"."source_payment_id" IS NULL AND "payments"."provider" IS NOT NULL AND "payments"."payment_code" IS NOT NULL AND "payments"."provider_payment_id" IS NOT NULL AND "payments"."hold_token_hash" IS NOT NULL) OR ("payments"."type" = 'DEPOSIT_REFUND' AND num_nonnulls("payments"."booking_id", "payments"."reservation_id") <= 1 AND "payments"."rental_id" IS NOT NULL AND "payments"."source_payment_id" IS NOT NULL AND "payments"."provider" IS NULL AND "payments"."payment_code" IS NULL AND "payments"."provider_payment_id" IS NULL AND "payments"."hold_token_hash" IS NULL AND "payments"."status" IN ('REFUND_PENDING', 'REFUNDED'))

policy_violation_fee_reference_valid.name: policy_violation_fee_reference_valid
policy_violation_fee_reference_valid.value: ("policy_violation_fee"."reference_type" IS NULL AND "policy_violation_fee"."reference_id" IS NULL) OR ("policy_violation_fee"."reference_type" IS NOT NULL AND "policy_violation_fee"."reference_id" IS NOT NULL AND "policy_violation_fee"."is_active" = false)

support_ticket_context_valid.name: support_ticket_context_valid
support_ticket_context_valid.value: ("support_tickets"."category" = 'PAYMENT' AND "support_tickets"."rental_id" IS NULL) OR ("support_tickets"."category" != 'PAYMENT' AND "support_tickets"."rental_id" IS NOT NULL AND "support_tickets"."payment_id" IS NULL)

system_settings_known_integer.name: system_settings_known_integer
system_settings_known_integer.value: "system_settings"."key" not in ('EXPIRY_REMINDER_DAYS', 'ABANDONED_REVIEW_DAYS', 'OVERDUE_FEE_RATE', 'DEPOSIT_MONTHS', 'OPENING_HOUR', 'CLOSING_HOUR') or (jsonb_typeof("system_settings"."value") = 'number' and ("system_settings"."value" #>> '{}')::numeric between 0 and 2147483647 and trunc(("system_settings"."value" #>> '{}')::numeric) = ("system_settings"."value" #>> '{}')::numeric)
